title: Hypocrisy
lead: Hypocrisy is acting out a goodness one does not have: honoring God with the lips while the heart is far away. The prophets attack it, Jesus charges some religious leaders with it again and again (Matthew 23), and Jewish writings from the time between the Testaments, such as the Psalms of Solomon, attack it in their own rivals.

sections.b: Isaiah hears God say that "this people draws near with its mouth / and honors me with its lips / but has moved its heart far from me" (Isaiah 29:13), and Jesus quotes the verse against those who put human rules above God's command (Matthew 15:7-9). In the Sermon on the Mount he warns against giving, praying and fasting to be seen by others (Matthew 6:1-18), and in Matthew 23 he calls some scribes and Pharisees hypocrites, "crammed with hypocrisy and lawlessness" (Matthew 23:28).
